d: The Head of Finance role within a fast-growing securities entity requires expertise in accounting, finance and treasury to lead financial operations and strategy. This position involves overseeing financial planning, consolidation, reporting, and regulatory compliance to support the group's business growth. This role reports to the local CEO and the Group CFO.
q: At least 10 years solid experience in audit and securities firms and knowledge in financial industry products
Degree Holder in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent certification.
Strong knowledge of accounting and reporting standards
In-depth knowledge and experience in handling local capital adequacy rules is a MUST.
Proven leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to mentor and develop high-performing teams.
Strong sense of business acumen, analytical, communication and reporting skills;
Mature, agile and demonstrate a positive mindset
Proficiency in computer literacy, ERP platforms, open-minded mindset in embracing AI, new-gen accounting and control system
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Good command in both spoken & written English is a MUST. Mandarin speaking is an advantage.
